desc:
The TISHA is a compact, high-performance K-size suppressor engineered to deliver very low back pressure and strong muzzle suppression in a short, lightweight package. Designed for hard-use rifles, it combines advanced internal geometry with durable materials to achieve sound performance that exceeds its size class.

Key Details:

Ultra-Compact Design: 4.1” length with only 3.8” added to barrel when mounted using the included Plan B system.

Low Back Pressure Performance: Engineered to balance reduced gas blowback with effective muzzle and shooter’s-ear suppression.

Lightweight Construction: 10.5 oz (titanium, no mount); Inconel version planned for Q1 2026 (estimated 16–18 oz).

Mounting: ½-28 direct thread
